QUOTE: `PermissionManager::pattern_matches` (`src/mcp/permission_manager.cpp:101`) splits each pattern at the first `:`: ... `filesystem.read_file` | fnmatch against the tool name | (none) | Every call to that tool, any args
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that patterns are split at the first colon into a tool part (fnmatch) and an argument part, and that a pattern with no colon matches on the tool name alone, regardless of arguments.
